features.name: title_exact_match
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 0 if either title is empty.
features.rationale: Exact match indicator between cleaned BibTeX title and candidate reference title.

features.name: title_jaccard_word
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 0.0 if either title has no tokens.
features.rationale: Token-level Jaccard similarity of normalized words in titles.

features.name: title_levenshtein_ratio
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 0.0 if either title is empty.
features.rationale: Character-level Levenshtein similarity ratio for typo resilience.

features.name: title_char_ngram_cosine
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 0.0 if either title has fewer than 3 characters.

features.name: title_len_diff_ratio
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 1.0 if either title is empty.
features.rationale: Normalized relative length difference between titles.

features.name: author_jaccard_last
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 0.0 if author lists cannot be parsed.
features.rationale: Jaccard similarity between sets of authors' standardized last names.

features.name: first_author_match
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 0 if first author is missing on either side.
features.rationale: Indicator if primary/first author last name matches exactly.

features.name: author_count_diff
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 0 if both lists are empty.
features.rationale: Absolute difference in parsed author counts (capped at 100).

features.name: doi_exact_match
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 0 if DOI is missing on either side.
features.rationale: High-precision exact match of canonical DOIs.

features.name: has_doi_both
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 0 if either entity lacks a DOI.
features.rationale: Indicator whether both BibTeX and candidate possess DOI metadata.

features.name: arxiv_id_match
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 0 if no arXiv ID can be extracted from BibTeX.
features.rationale: Direct match between BibTeX-extracted arXiv ID and candidate ref_arxiv_id.

features.name: year_exact_match
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 0 if year is missing on either side.
features.rationale: Indicator if publication years are identical.

features.name: year_diff_abs
features.missing_policy: Imputed to 99.0 if year is missing on either side.
features.rationale: Absolute difference in publication years (penalizes distant citations).

features.name: year_is_chronological
features.missing_policy: Defaults to 1 if citing year cannot be established.
features.rationale: Physical validity check: cited reference year <= citing publication year.

features.name: is_bib_year_missing
features.rationale: Missingness indicator flag for BibTeX publication year.

features.name: is_ref_year_missing
features.rationale: Missingness indicator flag for Reference publication year.
